meta.title: Little Fern | Neighbourhood cafe on Acre Lane, Brixton
meta.description: Speciality coffee, all-day breakfast, sourdough toasties and homemade cake on Acre Lane, Brixton. Dogs welcome. Open 7.30am to 4pm, closed Mondays.

rationale: Everything sits in one terracotta hue: a mid clay background with a deep brown-red ink, so the cafe feels like a warm room rather than a trendy white box. Fraunces headings with Karla body text give a soft, handmade tone. The offset photo hero, a letter from Fern and a featured toastie with a short side menu come from what the cafe actually has: a menu, a baker mum and a regulars' crowd. The fern and cup drawing and the huge opening time are the bold moves.

paragraphs: Little Fern is a small cafe on Acre Lane, and I wanted it to feel like somewhere you can stay for the whole morning. Sit by the window, plug in, order another coffee. Nobody will hurry you.

The coffee comes from a small roaster in Bristol. The cakes are baked by my mum at home and brought in each morning, so what is under the glass changes. If you have a favourite, tell us and we will pass it on.
Dogs are very welcome, and so are buggies. We are closed on Mondays, because everyone needs a day to sleep.
